finalText:
Scanned all 97 files.

~1,290 hits in 94 files. Most are safe. **Six zones are not.**

| Zone | Hits | Call |
|---|---|---|
| Service JS locals and params | ~1,080 | rename |
| SQL strings in repos | 125 | freeze, DB column unchanged |
| [migrations/](migrations/20250114_create_accounts.sql:9) | 61 | freeze, applied history, breaks `down` |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk/](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/schema.js:7) | 20 | freeze, `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:40) | 5 | freeze, public contract |
| [lib/serialize.js](lib/serialize.js:8) `WIRE` | 2 | freeze, public wire name |

The trap: 25 repo files write `{ ...values, account_id }` into the `payload` JSONB. A blind rename silently changes stored data.

Next: scope the sign off to JS names only.
